    • isMayAlias

      boolean isMayAlias(SootMethod m, Value va, Value vb)
      Returns whether va and vb, evaluated in method m, may point to a common runtime object. Supports Local references and null/String/class constants; any other Value kind is rejected with IllegalArgumentException.
